sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列，现已上线，您可以在各大播客平台收听。

sentences.en: Our episodes deal with serious and often distressing incidents.
sentences.zh: 我们的节目涉及严肃且往往令人不安的事件。

sentences.en: If you feel at any time you need support, please contact your local crisis centre.
sentences.zh: 如果您在任何时候感到需要支持，请联系您当地的危机干预中心。

sentences.en: For suggested phone numbers for confidential support, please see the show notes for this episode on your app, or on our website.
sentences.zh: 如需获取保密支持的建议电话号码，请查看您应用内本集节目的说明，或访问我们的网站。

sentences.en: The Kuala Lumpur International Airport in the capital of Malaysia has been likened to a dizzying maze.
sentences.zh: 马来西亚首都的吉隆坡国际机场常被比作一个令人眼花缭乱的迷宫。

sentences.en: Built on top of what was once agricultural land, it sprawls across 100 square kilometres and comprises multiple terminals, buildings, and stories.
sentences.zh: 它建在曾经的农田之上，占地100平方公里，包含多个航站楼、建筑和楼层。

sentences.en: From above, it resembles a giant letter X and was designed to reference Islamic geometry.
sentences.zh: 从高空俯瞰，它像一个巨大的字母“X”，其设计旨在呼应伊斯兰几何艺术。

sentences.en: There are two main terminals, both of which are divided into further terminals.
sentences.zh: 机场有两个主要航站楼，每个航站楼又进一步细分为多个区域。

sentences.en: Inside, they're sleek and modern, with high ceilings and wide glass windows.
sentences.zh: 内部设计时尚现代，拥有高挑的天花板和宽大的玻璃窗。

sentences.en: Every year, tens of millions of passengers from all over the world arrive at the airport and bustle through its halls to check into flights, drop off their baggage,
sentences.zh: 每年，来自世界各地的数千万旅客抵达这里，在航站楼大厅里行色匆匆，办理登机手续、托运行李，

sentences.en: and shop until the time comes to board their plane.
sentences.zh: 并在登机前尽情购物。

sentences.en: At 9am on Monday, February 13, 2017, 25-year-old Siti Aisha was one of many individuals standing in the busy departures hall on Level 3 of the airport's second terminal.
sentences.zh: 2017年2月13日，星期一，上午9点，25岁的西蒂·艾莎（Siti Aisha）正站在机场二号航站楼三楼繁忙的出发大厅里。

sentences.en: Known as KLIA-2, this terminal was constructed to accommodate various low-cost carriers that operate throughout the Asia region.
sentences.zh: 这个被称为KLIA-2的航站楼是为容纳在亚洲地区运营的各类廉价航空公司而建的。

sentences.en: But Siti wasn't there to board a flight.
sentences.zh: 但西蒂并不是来赶飞机的。

sentences.en: Instead, the young woman was there as part of a role she'd been given as the star of a reality prank show that was uploaded to YouTube.
sentences.zh: 相反，这位年轻女子出现在这里，是因为她受邀担任一部上传至YouTube的真人恶搞秀的主角。

sentences.en: And she was about to embark on her most thrilling mission yet.
sentences.zh: 而她即将开启迄今为止最刺激的一次任务。

sentences.en: Siti Aisha had relocated to Malaysia from her home country of Indonesia after the breakdown of her marriage.
sentences.zh: 西蒂·艾莎在婚姻破裂后，从家乡印度尼西亚移居到了马来西亚。

sentences.en: She and her ex had a seven-year-old son named Rio.
sentences.zh: 她和前夫有一个七岁的儿子，名叫里奥（Rio）。

sentences.en: Now a single mother, Siti desperately needed to earn a living so she could provide for him.
sentences.zh: 如今作为单亲妈妈，西蒂迫切需要赚钱来抚养孩子。

sentences.en: She left Rio with her parents-in-law and travelled to Kuala Lumpur, where she began working as a masseuse at the sprawling Lakeside Flamingo Hotel.
sentences.zh: 她把里奥留给公婆照顾，自己前往吉隆坡，在规模庞大的湖畔火烈鸟酒店（Lakeside Flamingo Hotel）做按摩师。

sentences.en: The job only paid about seven Australian dollars per customer.
sentences.zh: 这份工作每接待一位顾客仅能赚取约7澳元。

sentences.en: At night, she undertook sex work, regularly going to a nightclub called the Beach Club Café to meet clients.
sentences.zh: 晚上，她还会从事性工作，经常去一家名为“海滩俱乐部咖啡馆”（Beach Club Café）的夜店招揽客户。

sentences.en: At the beginning of January 2017, Siti met a taxi driver at the Beach Club Café who said he might know of an opportunity for her.
sentences.zh: 2017年1月初，西蒂在海滩俱乐部咖啡馆遇到了一名出租车司机，对方说他可能知道一个适合她的机会。

sentences.en: He had a Japanese client named James who was the producer of a popular show that streamed on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 他有一位名叫詹姆斯（James）的日本客户，是YouTube上一档热门节目的制作人。

sentences.en: James needed young women to appear on his online series.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯需要年轻女性在他的网络系列节目中出镜。

sentences.en: With her wide eyes, pretty features and youthful face, Siti was exactly what he was looking for.
sentences.zh: 西蒂有着一双大眼睛、精致的五官和年轻的面孔，正是他要找的人。

sentences.en: The driver put Siti in touch with James.
sentences.zh: 司机帮西蒂联系上了詹姆斯。

sentences.en: The very next day, she headed to an upscale shopping mall to meet him in person.
sentences.zh: 第二天，她就前往一家高档购物中心与他见面。

sentences.en: James was young and good-looking, but seemed a little shy.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯年轻帅气，但看起来有些害羞。

sentences.en: He explained that he was behind a hidden camera prank show that had a huge audience in Japan.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，他正在制作一档在日本拥有庞大观众群的隐藏摄像机恶搞节目。

sentences.en: He needed young women who could carry out practical jokes on unsuspecting bystanders.
sentences.zh: 他需要年轻女性对毫无防备的路人进行恶作剧。

sentences.en: The pay was impressive.
sentences.zh: 报酬非常可观。

sentences.en: James was offering the equivalent of 145 Australian dollars per job.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯开出的条件是每完成一次任务支付相当于145澳元的报酬。

sentences.en: The pranks were simple and straightforward.
sentences.zh: 恶作剧的内容简单直接。

sentences.en: All Siti had to do was approach men at random, smear their faces with baby oil, quickly apologise, and walk away before they even registered what had happened.
sentences.zh: 西蒂只需要随机接近男性，往他们脸上抹婴儿油，迅速道歉，然后在对方还没反应过来发生了什么之前走开即可。

sentences.en: There wouldn't be any awkward confrontation afterwards and she'd never have to see the person again.
sentences.zh: 事后不会有任何尴尬的对峙，她也永远不必再见到那个人。

sentences.en: Siti thought the premise sounded absurd.
sentences.zh: 西蒂觉得这个前提听起来很荒谬。

sentences.en: What was so funny about rubbing oil on a stranger's face?
sentences.zh: 往陌生人脸上抹油有什么好笑的？

sentences.en: But, James assured her, Japanese audiences loved it.
sentences.zh: 但詹姆斯向她保证，日本观众就喜欢这一套。

sentences.en: Though Siti was nervous that someone she pranked might get angry or violent, the money was too good to refuse.
sentences.zh: 虽然西蒂担心被恶搞的人可能会生气或动粗，但这份报酬实在让人无法拒绝。

sentences.en: She agreed to give it a go.
sentences.zh: 她同意试一试。

sentences.en: Right then and there, James took out a small bottle.
sentences.zh: 就在当时当地，詹姆斯拿出了一个小瓶子。

sentences.en: He poured baby oil on Siti's hands before she nervously approached her first victim.
sentences.zh: 他在西蒂手上倒了些婴儿油，随后西蒂紧张地走向了她的第一个目标。

sentences.en: James watched from a distance, filming the moment on his iPhone.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯在远处观察，并用iPhone记录下了这一刻。

sentences.en: Siti's heart raced as she walked right up to an oblivious stranger.
sentences.zh: 当西蒂径直走向一个毫无察觉的陌生人时，她的心跳加速了。

sentences.en: She raised her hands, smeared the oil across his face, and walked away.
sentences.zh: 她抬起手，把油抹在他的脸上，然后走开了。

sentences.en: When she faced no repercussions, Siti felt a huge surge of relief.
sentences.zh: 当发现没有任何后果时，西蒂感到一阵巨大的解脱。

sentences.en: She returned to James, who praised her work.
sentences.zh: 她回到詹姆斯身边，对方称赞了她的表现。

sentences.en: With growing confidence, Siti approached two more victiMs.
sentences.zh: 随着自信心增强，西蒂又接近了另外两名受害者。

sentences.en: Both of these attempts went as smoothly as the firSt.
sentences.zh: 这两次尝试都和第一次一样顺利。

sentences.en: James was impressed.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯印象深刻。

sentences.en: He congratulated Siti on her efforts, telling her she'd done a great job and he'd be happy to hire her again if she was keen.
sentences.zh: 他祝贺西蒂的表现，告诉她干得非常漂亮，如果她愿意，他很乐意再次雇佣她。

sentences.en: She was.
sentences.zh: 她愿意。

sentences.en: In just 15 minutes, she'd made 20 times the amount she was paid for each client at her regular job.
sentences.zh: 仅仅15分钟，她赚到的钱就是她平时做按摩工作接待一位客户报酬的20倍。

sentences.en: Over the next few weeks, Siti met up with James at various shopping malls.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几周里，西蒂在不同的购物中心与詹姆斯会面。

sentences.en: They established a routine.
sentences.zh: 他们建立了一套固定的流程。

sentences.en: James would apply baby oil or lotion to Siti's hands, then she would approach men from behind and rub their faces while James filmed her.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯会把婴儿油或乳液涂在西蒂手上，然后她从背后接近男性，揉搓他们的脸，同时詹姆斯负责拍摄。

sentences.en: James also had Siti play pranks at Kuala Lumpur International Airport.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯还让西蒂在吉隆坡国际机场进行恶作剧。

sentences.en: Its busy terminal swarmed with people, providing an abundance of potential victiMs.
sentences.zh: 繁忙的航站楼里人潮涌动，提供了大量的潜在目标。

sentences.en: The work was easy and over time, James increased her pay.
sentences.zh: 工作很轻松，随着时间的推移，詹姆斯还提高了她的报酬。

sentences.en: Siti couldn't believe her luck.
sentences.zh: 西蒂简直不敢相信自己的好运。

sentences.en: She gushed to her friends about how she'd landed on her feet after struggling for so long.
sentences.zh: 她向朋友们滔滔不绝地讲述自己在经历了长期的挣扎后，终于时来运转。

sentences.en: Moreover, she found herself increasingly attracted to James, charmed by his handsome face and shy personality.
sentences.zh: 此外，她发现自己越来越被詹姆斯吸引，被他帅气的脸庞和害羞的性格所迷住。

sentences.en: He couldn't speak Indonesian and she couldn't understand Japanese, but the pair communicated to one another by using Google Translate on their smartphones.
sentences.zh: 他不会说印尼语，她也听不懂日语，但两人通过智能手机上的谷歌翻译进行交流。

sentences.en: James told her he might be able to take her to the United States one day.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯告诉她，也许有一天能带她去美国。

sentences.en: Thrilled, Siti began daydreaming about the promising future unfurling before her.
sentences.zh: 西蒂兴奋不已，开始憧憬着未来展开的美好前景。

sentences.en: But before travelling to America with the James,
sentences.zh: 但在与詹姆斯前往美国之前，

sentences.en: Siti was referred to another producer named Mr Chang.
sentences.zh: 西蒂被介绍给了另一位名叫张先生（Mr Chang）的制作人。

sentences.en: He flew Siti out to Phnom Penh in Cambodia to carry out more pranks.
sentences.zh: 他安排西蒂飞往柬埔寨金边去执行更多的恶作剧任务。

sentences.en: Mr Chang was stern and serious, which unsettled Siti.
sentences.zh: 张先生严肃刻板，这让西蒂感到不安。

sentences.en: Despite this, she performed well.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，她的表现依然出色。

sentences.en: Mr Chang was so impressed that he gifted Siti a $200 bonus.
sentences.zh: 张先生非常满意，给了西蒂200美元的奖金。

sentences.en: In fact, on Saturday February 12, he told her that the team was so delighted with her work that they'd decided to task her with a very important job next time.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在2月12日星期六，他告诉西蒂，团队对她的工作非常满意，决定下次派给她一个非常重要的任务。

sentences.en: One that could make her world famous.
sentences.zh: 一个能让她闻名世界的任务。

sentences.en: Happy and flush with cash, Siti celebrated her 25th birthday on Sunday February 12 by throwing a party at a restaurant.
sentences.zh: 西蒂心情愉悦，手头宽裕，于2月12日星期日在一间餐厅举办派对，庆祝了自己的25岁生日。

sentences.en: She had already informed her friends of her good news.
sentences.zh: 她已经把这个好消息告诉了朋友们。

sentences.en: As they filmed a short clip of their celebrations on her phone, one of them cried out,
sentences.zh: 当她们用手机拍摄庆祝活动的短片时，其中一人大喊道：

sentences.en: Siti is going to be a celebrity.
sentences.zh: “西蒂要成为名人啦！”

sentences.en: Early the following morning, Siti met Mr Chang at one of Kuala Lumpur Airport's cafes for her next job.
sentences.zh: 第二天一早，西蒂在吉隆坡机场的一家咖啡馆见到了张先生，准备执行下一次任务。

sentences.en: Upon seeing her,
sentences.zh: 见到她后，

sentences.en: Mr Chang began explaining what he had in mind for that day's special project.
sentences.zh: 张先生开始解释他为当天的特别项目所做的构思。

sentences.en: Up until now, every one of the pranks Siti carried out had followed the same formula.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，西蒂执行的每一次恶作剧都遵循着同样的模式。

sentences.en: She had approached a man at random from behind, rubbed lotion or oil on his face, then apologised and walked away.
sentences.zh: 她从背后随机接近一名男子，把乳液或油抹在他脸上，然后道歉并走开。

sentences.en: This time,
sentences.zh: 这一次，

sentences.en: Mr Chang wanted something a little different.
sentences.zh: 张先生想要一点不同的东西。

sentences.en: For starters, he needed Siti to target a particular man who was going to be at the airport.
sentences.zh: 首先，他需要西蒂针对一名特定男子，此人当时正好在机场。

sentences.en: This individual was a high-ranking boss at his company, renowned for being rude and arrogant.
sentences.zh: 此人是他公司的一位高层老板，以粗鲁和傲慢著称。

sentences.en: The humiliating prank would be exactly what was needed to take him down a peg or two, but his volatile personality meant he might lash out at Siti.
sentences.zh: 这个羞辱性的恶作剧正是挫挫他锐气的绝佳手段，但由于他性格暴躁，可能会对西蒂发火。

sentences.en: For that reason, she needed to be particularly careful and get away as quickly as possible after she was done.
sentences.zh: 因此，她必须格外小心，并在得手后尽快离开。

sentences.en: Siti had also committed every previous prank by herself.
sentences.zh: 西蒂之前的所有恶作剧也都是独自完成的。

sentences.en: This time, she wouldn't be working solo.
sentences.zh: 这一次，她将不再是单打独斗。

sentences.en: Another young woman employed by the show would also be participating and would approach the target from another angle.
sentences.zh: 节目组雇佣的另一名年轻女子也会参与，并会从另一个角度接近目标。

sentences.en: The goal was for the two to reach him at almost exactly the same time, then flee as swiftly as possible.
sentences.zh: 目标是两人几乎同时接近他，然后以最快的速度逃离。

sentences.en: Siti was ready.
sentences.zh: 西蒂准备好了。

sentences.en: Mr Chang pulled out a small, treble-sized bottle.
sentences.zh: 张先生拿出一个小瓶子，瓶身是普通瓶子的三倍大。

sentences.en: He poured some sticky, greasy fluid on her hands.
sentences.zh: 他在她手上倒了一些黏糊糊、油腻腻的液体。

sentences.en: Then, he steered her towards the bustling departures lounge and pointed out the man she was to prank.
sentences.zh: 随后，他引导她走向繁忙的出发大厅，并指出了她要恶作剧的目标。

sentences.en: He was standing at one of the many self-check-in kiosks, tapping away at the screen to obtain the boarding pass for his flight.
sentences.zh: 那人正站在众多自助值机柜台前，在屏幕上敲敲打打，办理登机牌。

sentences.en: The man was large, balding and middle-aged with an East Asian appearance.
sentences.zh: 那名男子身材魁梧，秃顶，中年，长着一张东亚面孔。

sentences.en: He was dressed in a pale grey, expensive-looking blazer and light jeans.
sentences.zh: 他穿着一件浅灰色、看起来很昂贵的西装外套和浅色牛仔裤。

sentences.en: A dark-coloured backpack was slung over his right shoulder.
sentences.zh: 右肩上斜挎着一个深色的背包。

sentences.en: Siti's heart beat quickly as she nervously made her way through the crowds towards the man.
sentences.zh: 西蒂心跳加速，紧张地穿过人群走向那名男子。

sentences.en: He looked like a wealthy and important person.
sentences.zh: 他看起来像是个富有且重要的人物。

sentences.en: What if he called the police?
sentences.zh: 如果他报警怎么办？

sentences.en: But, though she was scared,
sentences.zh: 但是，尽管害怕，

sentences.en: Siti kept going, determined to complete the job.
sentences.zh: 西蒂还是继续前行，决心完成任务。

sentences.en: She drew closer.
sentences.zh: 她越靠越近。

sentences.en: When she was no more than two steps away from the man, she saw another young woman cut in front of her and cover the man's eyes with her hands.
sentences.zh: 当她距离那名男子不到两步远时，她看到另一名年轻女子抢在她前面，用双手蒙住了男子的眼睛。

sentences.en: Siti joined her and quickly wiped her own sticky, lotion-smeared hands across the man's face.
sentences.zh: 西蒂紧随其后，迅速将自己手上黏糊糊的乳液抹在那名男子的脸上。

sentences.en: He looked irritated and upset, which did nothing to calm Siti's nerves.
sentences.zh: 他看起来既恼火又困惑，这让西蒂更加紧张。

sentences.en: Within a few seconds, the prank was over.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟内，恶作剧就结束了。

sentences.en: The other woman was striding away.
sentences.zh: 另一名女子大步走开了。

sentences.en: Siti followed suit, heading in another direction towards a bathroom so she could wash the remainder of the lotion off her hands.
sentences.zh: 西蒂也照做，朝另一个方向走向洗手间，以便洗掉手上残留的乳液。

sentences.en: Siti decided to grab a bite to eat, then browsed some of the airport shops, before heading home.
sentences.zh: 西蒂决定吃点东西，然后逛了逛机场商店，随后便回家了。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile稍后回来。

sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本集节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本集节目的广告。
